intent: Amend the dharmagraph shared seam to exactly six implementation files required to prevent a queued campaign owner from starting or widening a provider effect after durable pause: AgentPool exact reservation/release ownership CAS; Orchestrator exact-principal routing, effect-fence threading, and readiness handshake; AgentRunner closed route-lock consumption and response identity validation; and ModelRouter/provider request-scoped single-attempt, fallback-free, exact-model execution. This admission changes no runtime behavior and leaves all campaign authority/session/recovery semantics to the sibling organism packet.

dharmagraph_provides: AgentPool.reserve(agent_id, task_id) and release_reservation(agent_id, task_id) ownership CAS
exact campaign principal selection with no preferred-agent fallback
provider-boundary effect fence and readiness handshake
request-scoped one-attempt, fallback-free exact-provider/model invocation with served-identity validation
organism_provides: typed authority, lease, attempt, and recovery evidence
cross_packet_interface.shared_proof: dispatch does not return and release campaign control serialization until the exact owner either reaches a final validated pre-provider boundary or terminates without provider effect

interface_mismatches: Orchestrator dispatch historically returns immediately after scheduling a background task, allowing pause to commit before the background owner enters its provider.
Preferred-agent routing is advisory and can fall back to another idle agent; authenticated campaign authority requires exact-one current principal or no dispatch.
AgentPool internal lock/state are private; the supervisor needs only bounded atomic reserve/release methods and must never reach into private fields.

ModelRouter's process-wide retry policy and Ollama's internal frontier fallback can each create multiple effects inside one campaign generation; the campaign restriction must be request-scoped and must not mutate shared router/provider state.

Ollama cloud authority names a logical roster ID ending in :cloud while its HTTP wire ID omits only that suffix; the provider must attest the exact wire ID before returning the exact logical identity.

Generic Orchestrator retries can reuse one identity, while typed campaign generations and pre-effect recovery are organism-owned and must bypass generic requeue without changing non-campaign behavior.
honest_blockers: Admission performs no provider, verifier, task, lease, process, transport, deployment, or external-world effect.
The final pre-provider callback is a trusted-process fence for the sole production supervisor, not an opaque membrane against hostile in-process plugins.
Crossing the final provider boundary is not cancellable by this packet; pause/stop fence later starts but provider cancellation remains a separate invoker concern.
The exact-model carrier is restriction-only and cannot grant campaign authority; it is emitted only after the typed task authority and route lock validate.

Exact-model execution is fail-closed per provider implementation. The admitted SADHANA roster is Ollama-only; any future provider must add and prove its own non-multiplexing exact-model implementation before campaign use.
AgentPool reservation proves only local ownership state, not provider liveness, semantic usefulness, acceptance, promotion, merge, or publication.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the later six-file implementation and this admission. Generic routing remains the prior behavior, but campaign dispatch must stay disabled because queued-before-pause protection, exact reservation CAS, and single-model provider execution would no longer be proved. Preserve all TaskBoard, RuntimeState, lease, and provider evidence; no external effect is authorized by admission rollback.
